title: AlphaFold 3 predicts a PCNA-Pds5-Eco1 cohesin acetylation complex on nicked DNA
summary: AlphaFold 3 predicted a budding yeast cohesin acetylation complex of PCNA, Pds5 and the Eco1 acetyltransferase that contacts nicked DNA, with predicted conformational changes placing acetyl-CoA near the target Smc3 lysine. Biochemical and genetic experiments confirmed anticipated features of this reaction trajectory, and related complexes are predicted in other eukaryotes including humans. Only the abstract was reviewed, so the extent of each confirmed feature is not known.
ai_technology: AlphaFold 3 structure prediction of a multiprotein-DNA complex

evidence.tested: Biochemical and genetic experiments in budding yeast.
evidence.unknown: Which predicted features were confirmed and how strongly; whether the human complex forms; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold 3 generated the complex hypothesis and conformational model.
